reviews.title: Used to be a good game
reviews.text: The game is  designed, but a hefty monthly fee for a game for a 5 year old is ludicrous.  I can’t imagine the business meeting where a bunch of grown adults said hey let’s block out a bunch of features in the game and make them available by subscription.  I stopped letting my kid play the game at all and removed it from my device. I would have happily bought the game for a fee.  Great job on the product, swing and a miss on the revenue model.  Bluey also needs to do a better job with managing their licensing, because this is against the point of the brand.
